items.item: `Sources/Package Manager/Package.Manager+Dump.swift` and `Package.Manager+Edit.swift`: any termination by a sig
items.reason: Done inside this package rather than in swift-process (not my repository): dump, run (edit/unedit) and toolchain time the spawn and report timedOut (or locked) only when the process was signalled and the timeout had elapsed; any other signal is .command(termination: .signaled(...)). A process-layer timeout flag in swift-process would be cleaner and could replace the elapsed-time check later. Test: kill -TERM $$ script gives .command(.signaled(15)).

Now throws(Package.Manifest.Identity.Conflict.Error.resolved(document:)) for invalid JSON or no pins array; also reads the Package.resolved v1 layout (object.pins[].repositoryURL) so valid v1 files do not start throwing.

items.item: `Sources/Package Manager/Package.Manager+Catalog.swift`: the digest covers `Package.swift` only. Include ver
items.reason: manifestSource now appends every Package@swift-*.swift (sorted, name-delimited) after Package.swift, so both the digest and the manifestChanged check cover them; digest of a package with only Package.swift is unchanged. Tests: digest changes when a versioned manifest is added; a wrapper executable that edits Package.swift during dump-package yields manifestChanged.
